Definition
[Stratification] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0430 1. appG:G.51\group Aleksandrov structure A stratification $X=\bigsqcup _{i=1}^N X_i$ into topological manifolds has $\dim X_1>\cdots >\dim X_N$ and closed unions $X_k^+=\bigcup _{i=k}^N X_i$. The sets $X_i$ are its strata.
